title: Newly Established Casino Equity Stake For Sale in Kobuleti, Georgia
tagline: Pre-operational, premium beachfront mixed-use development in Georgia, planned as a 50-level project combining a five-star hotel, luxury residences, casino facilities, and commercial spaces. - Located approximately 50 metres from the Black Sea, the project occupies an 11,235 m² land plot with direct access to the main coastal highway and connectivity to Batumi, international airports, and regional transport routes. - The project has an approved building height of 162 metres and approximately 80,000 m² of planned saleable area. - The proposed development targets international property buyers, hospitality operators, and investors seeking exposure to premium real estate and tourism-related opportunities. - Planned facilities include luxury residential units, hotel accommodation, casino facilities, and commercial spaces within an integrated beachfront destination. - Projected gross sales revenue is approximately USD 240 million, based on project estimates. - Architectural and engineering documentation has been prepared, and the project is positioned to move towards construction. - A casino licence is planned to be obtained at the commencement stage, with the promoters reporting existing industry contacts. Have applied for the construction permit and is expected to be approved in 2 months. - The estimated development timeline is five years to completion, with construction commencement planned following the required funding and preparations.
